sentences.en: To weep is to make less the depth of grief.
sentences.zh: 哭泣可以减轻悲痛的程度。

sentences.en: She went nearly mad with grief after the child died.
sentences.zh: 孩子死后她几乎因悲痛而发疯。

sentences.en: No one really understands the grief or joy of another.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正理解别人的悲痛或快乐。

senses.zh: 悲伤，悲痛；伤心事，悲痛的缘由；麻烦，烦恼
